IActionScript.title: script action
IActionScript.scriptMode_simple: Simple mode (just modify the executeAction() function)
IActionScript.modeDescription_simple: Simple mode: The framework handles the lifecycle automatically. You only need to implement the action logic in the provided executeAction() function. When the execution is successful, that.dispatchSuccess() is called, and when it fails, that.dispatchFailed(errorMessage) is called.
IActionScript.modeDescription_advanced: Advanced mode: You get the complete attach function and can fully customize all logic. Suitable for handling asynchronous operations, complex event listening and life cycle management.
IActionScript.modeDescription_full: Complete mode: Provides sample code including registration, export, and complete life cycle. Can be used directly as a standalone script.
